name: Agriculture, forestry and fishing

bnote.011101: No wheat grower is listed in India. These are listed farmland operators abroad that grow wheat among other grains.
bnote.011202: Adecoagro is one of South America's largest rice growers.
bnote.011201: No basmati grower is listed. Listed basmati companies (KRBL, LT Foods) are millers, which belong under food manufacturing.
bnote.011400: Indian sugar mills are manufacturers. These Brazilian companies grow most of their own cane.
bnote.011500: No listed tobacco grower found. Leaf buyers and processors are under preparation of tobacco leaves.
bnote.012100: Indian and global wine companies own vineyards but are classed as beverage manufacturers.
bnote.012699: Malaysian plantation groups (SD Guthrie, IOI, KLK) also fit but could not be read from the data source.
bnote.012701: Five listed Indian tea estate companies. Tea is a low-margin, labour-heavy business in India.
bnote.012702: Bombay Burmah owns coffee and tea estates. Its consolidated figures are dominated by Britannia.
bnote.012802: Licensed cannabis growers in North America.
bnote.016102: Closest listed match: Jain Irrigation makes and installs micro-irrigation systems.
bnote.032102: Closest Indian match: Avanti Feeds supplies shrimp feed and processes shrimp.
bnote.032105: Closest Indian match: Waterbase runs shrimp hatcheries and sells shrimp feed.

flags.bbtc: Consolidated figures include Britannia Industries, so plantations are a small part of these numbers.
flags.godrejagro: Diversified group: animal feed, crop protection, dairy and oil palm. Figures are for the whole group.
flags.cresud: Also owns a large real estate business, so figures are not farming alone.
flags.raizen: Mostly fuel distribution and sugar-ethanol. Cane growing is one part.
flags.genus: Net profit is above EBITDA because of a one-off gain, so the profit margin is not operating.
flags.grieg: Net profit includes a large one-off gain, so the profit margin is not operating.
flags.aac: Net profit despite negative EBITDA comes from livestock revaluation.
flags.alco: TTM revenue is unusually small for this company. Check the source page.
flags.vitl: Near-zero TTM profit makes the P/E meaningless.
flags.avo: Near-zero TTM profit makes the P/E meaningless.

notes: Section A: most farming is not listed anywhere

Grains, pulses, vegetables, spices and livestock are mostly grown by individual farmers or private estates, in India and abroad. Where a listed company exists only abroad, it is shown with its country and currency.
